'''Iron shield''' is an item. Like all tower shields, it is incapable of parrying and has a dramatic -20% movement speed penalty when drawn, but provides superior block power to other variants.

== Availability ==
Cannot currently be crafted. See [[Iron Tower Shield]] for the available iron tier tower shield.

== Upgrade information ==
Cannot currently be upgraded.

== Notes ==
Currently only obtainable via console commands and does not function properly. Rather than attaching to the hand, it seems to be attached to the air behind the left foot.

The '''knight shield''' is an unused asset with the appearance of a kite shield but the function of a round shield.

== Availability ==
Currently only obtainable via console commands. See [[Banded Shield]] for obtainable iron tier round shield.

== Notes ==
* It is currently not mounted properly in game. When equipped, it clips into the player's arm and when sheathed or blocking it is mounted/held sideways.
